tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas la gtang rag mnga' gsol gyi tshigs bcad dam can dgyes pa'i nga ro zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsa turmu kha ye/ hūm̐/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin sprul ni/ /gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms mthu stobs can/ /'phrin las drag po kun khyab pa'i/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas mnga' gsol lo/ /klu sgrub snying po ba liṃ ta/ /ye shes zhabs sogs 'phags yul gyi/ /paṇa grub rgya mtshos bsten pa'i lha/ /dam tshig mgon po༞ /lo chen gnyan dang kha'u pa/ /sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i/ /gdung brgyud bu slob bcas pa yi/ /bstan bsrung mgon po༞ /ti se'i gangs la gnas pa'i tshe/ /myur mgyogs dpa' bo mtshon cha 'dzin/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dmag dpon chen por༞ /gru 'dzin lhun por gnas pa'i tshe/ /srin po khros 'dra'i zhal bzhi las/ /rnam 'phrul grangs med pho nya 'gyed/ /sprul pa'i mnga' bdag༞ /sing ga'i gling na gnas pa'i tshe/ /mthu ldan nag po 'phrin las sgrub/ /'jigs gzugs sa gsum 'dar byed pa'i/ /'phrin las lhun grub༞ /bsil ba'i tshal na gnas pa'i tshe/ /dur khrod ma mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun gyis khyod bsten dpa' bo che/ /bram ze'i gzugs can༞ /ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod na/ /zhing skyong gdug pas yongs bskor ba'i/ /lha chen pho nya drag shul can/ /zhing skyong nag por༞ /me 'bar gnas gzhi bsrung ba'i tshe/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong slad du/ /phyogs kun myul zhing dgra bgegs 'joms/ /srung ma chen por༞ /sngon tshe rdo rje 'dzin drung du/ /khas blangs rgyud sde ma lus dang / /khyad par gsang 'dus dbu ma yis/ /chos srung nag por༞ /bar du ri sul rnal 'byor mas/ /lo chen gnyan la mngon sum du/ /g.yog tu bka' bsgos rjes 'brang ba'i/ /gnyan mgon nag por༞ /da lta rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /bdag gi lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /las kun sgrub ces bka' bsgos ltar/

/bka' bstod nag por༞ /rab 'jigs dur khrod mi bzad nas/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi sprul pa mchog /dpa' bo mi srun ngam nag pa/ /bdud 'dul chen por༞ /rab khros rngam zhal nag po gnyis/ /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mi ro za/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mche ba gtsigs/ /sgrol gying nag por༞ /sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar/ /kham nag skra brdzes khro gnyer bsdus/ /ma mchu 'phyang zhing byis pa'i gzugs/ /drag po nag por༞ /gri gug thod khrag dgra snying btub/ /ral gri mdung thung dgra la brdeg /res 'ga' dgra bo'i mgo 'phreng mnyed/ /'jigs byed chen por༞ /zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs kyis/ /dam nyams dgra la bro brdung zhing / /shugs pa'i glu len dmag tshogs 'gyed/ /khro gtum nag por༞ /mi mgo rgyu rlon rus pa'i 'phreng / /sbrul gdug rgyan dang stag sham can/ /sna tshogs dar dang tshangs skyud kyi/ /rnam par sgeg par༞ /ha ha'i gad mos bdud dpung 'joms/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bgegs tshogs skrod/ /phaiṃ sgras ma tshogs dbang du sdud/ /rngam pa'i sgra sgrog༞ /rab tu khros pa'i rnam sprul gyi/ /gdug pa drag pos tshar gcod cing / /snying rje med par gsod par byed/ /bstan dgra'i gshed mar༞ /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo ni/ /mdog nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /bstan dgra'i srog lus dum bur btub/ /'chi bdag gtso mor༞ /las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu ni/ /ma rgad mdangs can gri thod 'dzin/ /bstan dgra'i snying khrag khong nas 'thung / /bdud kyi gtso mor༞ /dmar nag srin mo chen mo ni/ /rak+ta'i mdog can gri thod 'dzin/ /dgra la smyo 'bog nad gtong ma/ /gshin rje'i gtso mor༞ /ser nag siṅga li ma ni/ /gser gyi mdog can gri thod 'dzin/ /dgra bo'i srog 'gugs gsod byed ma/ /sha za'i gtso mor༞ /dmag dpon stag zhon sku mdog nag /mdung rnon dgra la gsor zhing brdeg /dred zhon sku mdog mthing nag la/

/ral gri 'phyar zhing nyi zhags bsnams/ /gzig zhon khrag mdog rtse gsum 'dzin/ /'phar zhon dmar skya mdung ring thogs/ /sde brgyad yongs kyi kha lo bsgyur/ /dmag dpon rnam bzhir༞ /bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig ni/ /'phrin las sgrub la thogs mi mnga'/ /khyed rnams sku mdog mtshan smos pa/ /'gugs byed bshan pa nag po ni/ /g.yas pa lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa/ /'ching byed bshan pa dmar po ni/ /g.yas pa bdud zhags g.yon thod khrag /sgrog byed bshan pa dud kha ni/ /lcags sgrog mi mgo rlon pa za/ /'bebs byed bshan pa sngon po ni/ /dril bu dang ni snying dmar 'dzin/ /gsod byed bshan pa srog bdud ni/ /mthing nag ral gri thod khrag 'dzin/ /sgrol byed bshan pa mig dmar ni/ /ljang khu chu gri thod khrag 'dzin/ /dbugs len bshan pa stag khrag ni/ /sngon po dbyug tho dbugs rkyal 'dzin/ /mdangs 'phrog bshan pa nag po ni/ /gri gug snying dmar gtso la stob/ /khrag 'thung bshan pa dmar po ni/ /ral gri glo snying bzung nas za/ /dkrugs byed bshan pa gshin rje ni/ /ljang khu spu gri phur pa 'dzin/ /srog bdud bshan pa ro zan ni/ /dmar nag mi ro phrag la khur/ /khong khrag dmar 'dren bshan pa ni/ /sngon po mi mgo glo snying thogs/ /mna' zan bshan pa nag po ni/ /g.yas pa ral gri g.yon thod khrag /rig 'dzin srog shing dkar po ni/ /mi ro za zhing 'jigs tshul ston/ /srog gi sgo bdud nag po ni/ /gri gug thod khrag 'phyar zhing brdeg /drag shul bshan pa nag po ni/ /g.yas g.yon ral gri zhags pa thogs/ /snying ring bshan pa nag po ni/ /g.yas g.yon tho ba rkam pa thogs/ /bstan dgra'i bshan pa ser po ni/ /rgyu zhags thogs shing mdung thung brdeg /dam nyams srog len dmar po ni/ /tri shu la dang zhags pa 'dzin/ /dmar ba dug gdong nag po ni/ /g.yas pa ral gri g.yon thod khrag /phung byed khyung mgo mi lus nag /lcags kyu zhags pa khra bo thogs/

/gshog pa'i rlabs kyis gnam sa sdebs/ /thams cad mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dur khrod rgyan dang cha lugs 'chang / /mthong ba tsam gyis dgra snying 'byin/ /bshan pa'i 'khor tshogs༞ /gzhan yang khyod kyi bka' 'khor ni/ /gshin rje'i dmag tshogs ging dang bdud/ /sde brgyad srin po srin mo'i tshogs/ /sha za pho nya bla rkun mon/ /bal mo mon mo rgya gar mo/ /nyan thos sngags pa bon po dang / /bshan pa mi mo mi nag mo/ /bshan pa dmar po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'bag seng g.yag dang bya rog dang / /'ug pa srin bya ngur bya'i tshogs/ /sbrul sdig sbal pa la sogs pa/ /rnam sprul ma nges ci yang ston/ /dgra la mi dge'i ltas gtong ba'i/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtshor mnga' gsol lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas mchod/ /nyams chags skongs la dngos grub stsol/ /khyed la 'phrin las zhu ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /de 'dzin gang zag sku tshe brtan/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub rgyas par mdzod/ /khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa mi nyams yar zla ltar/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dge mtshan 'di/ /srid zhi'i dpal du brtan par mdzod/ /rigs gsum rnam sprul 'khon gyi gdung / /chu bo'i rgyun ltar byon nas kyang / /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /smin grol dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'dis mtshon pa'i/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du/ /nad 'khrug mu ge la sogs pa'i/ /mi mthun rgud tshogs zhi bar mdzod/ /char chu phebs shing lo phyugs legs/ /tshe ring nad med la sogs pa'i/ /bde skyid dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / /'di phyi'i don kun lhun grub mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub/ /snod bcud dbang bsdus dgra bgegs sgrol/ /mdor na deng nas byang chub bar/

/lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas kyang / /ci bsam don kun 'grub pa dang / /dngos grub mdzod/ /ces stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas la gtang rags mnga' gsol gyi tshigs bcad dam can dgyes pa'i nga ro zhes bya ba 'di ni sa smyon bhu su ku ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tshar chen chos gyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'phrin las myur mgyogs gyi spyan 'dren dang / gzungs dpal bas mdzad pas rbad bskul bshan pa nyer gcig gi mngon rtogs gter byung rnams la gzhi byas gong 'og tu sgrigs chags kyi tshig 'ga' yar bsnan te chu mo bya lo rgyal zla ba'i gtang rags mnga' gsol dang nye ba'i tshe mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can nyer dgu'i nyin dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chung 'grogs gzhu lung pa dang lcam mo ba drung yig spun gyis mgyogs par bgyis pa ka l+yān war+dhan+tu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas la gtang rag mnga' gsol gyi tshigs bcad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
